description: Audit mechanisms do not provide non-repudiation capabilities to prove that actions occurred. This signal indicates that users may be able to deny performing actions due to lack of cryptographic or tamper-evident logging.
applicability: Applicable to systems requiring strong accountability. Includes digitally signed logs, tamper-evident logging, write-once storage, and cryptographic timestamps.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through audit integrity mechanism review, log signing verification, and tamper detection capability assessment.
